checks: Source review: one provenance-bound archive link base; every parsed link remains checked, with canonical inventory paths, historical bytes/hash, duplicate-row rejection and symlink/traversal guards. No historical Markdown bytes rewritten.
Independent direct checks matched actual archive to retained historical manifest row and verified all 68 local link destinations from the original directory without importing the production parser.
Reviewed 16 focused control definitions/results and 35 recorded tooling controls; verified their source and receipt/log hashes.

Tooling delta adds only the explicitly authorized verifier and closed archive-context folder; exact mapping required in authorization and manifest. Prior scope, source/index guards, conditional gate/commit and atomic fast-forward compare-and-swap delivery retained.
Frozen index matches stated tree; verifier, helper, manifest and authorization pins match.
limitations: This is bounded source, provenance and recorded-control review, not a fresh execution of the control suite or full documentation gate. The main snapshot auditor and candidate/exact gates remain separate.
Historical manifest authenticity is grounded in the reviewed pinned provenance and authorization, not a cryptographic signature.
Existing Markdown regex and heuristic privacy checks are not a complete Markdown parser or exhaustive secret detector. No runtime, performance, Linux or workload outcome is established.
